sentences.en: To adopt a sentence, click on the white person icon.
sentences.zh: 1. 要采用一句话，请点击白色人像图标。

sentences.en: To release a sentence, click on the black person icon.
sentences.zh: 2. 要释放一句话，请点击黑色人像图标。

sentences.en: Click the play icon. Did they say the sentence accurately?
sentences.zh: 3. 点击播放图标。他们是否准确地说出了这句话？

phrases.zh: 1. 在图标上：在某个图标的上面或旁边操作

senses.zh: 图标，图像；偶像，代表人物；圣像；标志，象征
